# Vendored camera decoder

`html5-qrcode.min.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from the npm package
`html5-qrcode@2.3.8`, retrieved with `npm pack html5-qrcode@2.3.8`.

- SHA-256: `660b12437b1d747e3e68b8be0685c08cb728140110ad213f167b14b66f8b1d8e`
- SRI: `sha256-ZgsSQ3sddH4+aLi+BoXAjLcoFAEQrSE/FnsUtm+LHY4=`
- Upstream license: Apache-2.0; preserved in `html5-qrcode.LICENSE`

The external camera page loads this same-origin file only after it has removed
the launch fragment and completed its opener handshake.
